entries.description: Completing a B.S. in Information Systems through the Marriott School of Business, with a Software & Systems Development emphasis in a STEM-certified technical program (expected Fall 2027). Accepted into the Master of Information Systems Management (MISM) program and deferring enrollment until Fall 2027, beginning the master's upon completion of the bachelor's degree. Academic focus includes software development, data analytics, financial technology, systems design, and business-focused technology strategy.
